description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for the BCM6328 device in OpenWRT, including image validation and upgrade execution based on board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs a basic check to validate the firmware image; always returns success in this implementation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade procedures based on the board name. For 'sercomm,ad1018', it calls 'nand_do_upgrade', otherwise it defaults to 'default_do_upgrade'.
